1.web: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
1.asv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

2.web: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
2.asv: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before times eternal;

3.web: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior;
3.asv: but in his own seasons manifested his word in the message, wherewith I was intrusted according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

4.web: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
4.asv: to Titus, my true child after a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.

5.web: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you;
5.asv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;

6.web: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
6.asv: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.

7.web: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward; not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
7.asv: For the bishop must be blameless, as God’s steward; not self-willed, not soon angry, no brawler, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre;

8.web: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled;
8.asv: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;

9.web: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
9.asv: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able both to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict the gainsayers.

10.web: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
10.asv: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision,

11.web: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
11.asv: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.

12.web: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
12.asv: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.

13.web: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
13.asv: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

14.web: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
14.asv: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

15.web: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
15.asv: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

16.web: They profess that they know God, but by their works they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
16.asv: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
